correctness.rationale: The vertex-set description v(i,s;j,u)=(1-t)s e_i+t u e_j (48 for 0<t<1/2) is justified by nonoverlapping cap truncations. Multiaffinity of the 5-point determinant reduces any contained simplex to vertex extremizers. Independently enumerated all C(47,4)=178365 anchored determinants with a separate C++ polynomial enumerator: 258 signed profiles. A fresh rational Q(sqrt(2)) Bernstein check verified all 5160 nonnegative coefficients for A±P on [0,sqrt(2)-1] and B±P on [sqrt(2)-1,1/2]; only A and B attain open-phase equality, multiplicities 20 and 10 at the anchor. Independent signed-coordinate orbit enumeration produced 192 and 96 maximizers and 48 four-vertex-face pairs with same signed determinant, validating the one-apex segment equality analysis. At t=sqrt(2)-1 count 288 follows. Direct cross-polytope tip subtraction yields volume 2/3(1-4t^4), hence fraction 9/154 at t=1/3. Exhaustive finite determinant computation plus exact all-parameter positivity, rather than a parameter grid, proves the continuum bound.
